name: jaspersoft-tools
description: Jaspersoft and Talend automation for Claude Code: the jasper-deploy skill for designing, compiling, and deploying JasperReports Server artifacts (4.7-10.1 version/upgrade reference library), and the talend-etl skill: a complete Talend / Qlik Talend data-integration knowledge base (Studio, connectors, tMap, Spark, ESB, deployment, APIs, artifact formats, patterns) with offline job-inspection helpers.

plugins.name: jasper-deploy
plugins.description: Design, compile, and deploy JasperReports artifacts to JasperReports Server over REST v2: JR7 jrxml scaffolding from SQL, lint gate, dashboards via export-inject-import, datasources, Domains, OLAP, themes, scheduling, permissions, STAGE/PROD promotion, and doc-derived references covering JRS 4.7 through 10.1 including the upgrade/migration playbook. Requires PowerShell 5.1 or pwsh 7+, JDK 11+, psql, curl, Python 3, and a JasperReports 7.0.6 jar directory (see the skill's jrs.config.example.json).

plugins.name: talend-etl
plugins.description: Complete working knowledge of Talend / Qlik Talend data integration: Talend Studio (Standard, Spark, ESB Routes/Services, Data Quality, MDM), the connector library at parameter level, tMap and expression semantics, routines, build and deployment options (standalone, TAC/JobServer, Talend Cloud TMC/Remote Engine, Talend Runtime, Docker, CI Builder), the TMC/MetaServlet/CommandLine/Component Kit APIs, .item/.properties/Jobscript/export formats, version and licensing history, and a design-pattern and troubleshooting playbook. Offline Python 3 helpers inspect job .item files and exported job zips, encode TAC MetaServlet calls, and call the Talend Cloud API. Requires only Python 3 (stdlib).
